How to remove this update if it was automatically installed on your computer:

  1. Go to Control Panel>Programs>Programs and Features>Installed Updates
  2. In the top-right, search for "KB3068708"
  3. Click on the update, then click "Uninstall"
  4. Choose "Restart now" for the change to take effect.

How to disable automatic updates (Windows 8.1)

  1. Open the charms menu>Settings>Change PC Settings
  2. Go to Update and Recovery>Windows Update
  3. Click "Choose how updates get installed"
  4. Set the dropdown to whatever you wish, but uncheck both check boxes.
  5. Click Apply, and your changes will be saved.
